available_components: RADLADS-style conversion, Stage-1 alignment, and Stage-2 KL training source
one-restoration GA-S2 config generation and W&B loss-ranking scripts
synthetic layer-ablation baselines for seven diagnostic task families
171 YAML files spanning teachers, scales, mixers, budgets, selectors, and per-layer sweeps
fixed selected-layer configs including the reported Qwen and Llama layouts
Qwen2.5, Qwen3, and Llama 3.2 conversion adapters
identity_and_behavior_findings: the repository has no root license, so source inspection does not grant reuse rights
the paper scores expected KL on a held-out slice, while the documented code ranks sampled W&B train/loss values
the rolling-Jaccard and K-minus-one early-stop rule is not implemented in the inspected ranking script
per-layer config generation hard-codes a Stage-1 checkpoint path and expects manual editing
W&B entity/project/output constants and run naming require manual external state
torch, transformers, triton, and deepspeed are pinned but datasets, FLA, evaluation, and other dependencies are not
teacher/tokenizer/dataset repository revisions and DCLM mixture/order are not pinned
no checkpoints, W&B loss exports, final result tables, or assertion-based tests are stored in the tree
the evaluation task generator uses unseeded Python random calls unless external process state happens to set them
configuration count is broad, but behavioral parity across the reported matrix is not established

decision.next_action: retain as mandatory conceptual/config evidence; do not execute or reuse before rights, held-out-KL semantics, data identity, and deterministic evaluation are resolved
